title: Tötungsdelikt am Humboldt Forum – letzter Tatverdächtiger festgenommen

extraction.summaryEn: A 20-year-old man died after a brawl between two groups at the Humboldt Forum on 12 September 2025; two other men were slightly injured. The last suspect, a 16-year-old, was arrested at Gesundbrunnen station and remanded.
